visual_action: A rapid-fire montage of clips featuring Donald Trump in various settings. These include: standing in an ornate room, pointing to an altered weather map in the Oval Office, walking up airplane stairs, walking down a ramp with a military officer, speaking at rallies, standing on a stage with his name in large lights, wearing a safety vest by a truck, golfing, making expressive faces, standing before a table laden with fast food, speaking to reporters, and interacting with other public figures such as Hillary Clinton, Vladimir Putin, and Jeffrey Epstein. A brief clip of Elon Musk in the Oval Office is also included.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is the sole subject of the montage, appearing in nearly every frame of the video.

cast.name: Elon Musk
cast.evidence: Elon Musk appears in a brief clip standing in the Oval Office.

cast.name: Vladimir Putin
cast.evidence: Vladimir Putin is shown in one clip shaking hands with Donald Trump.

cast.name: Hillary Clinton
cast.evidence: Hillary Clinton is shown shaking hands with Donald Trump on a presidential debate stage.

cast.name: Jeffrey Epstein
cast.evidence: Jeffrey Epstein is shown in a brief archival clip standing next to Donald Trump at a party.

spoken_summary: The audio consists entirely of the song 'Beauty and a Beat' by Justin Bieber, featuring a rap verse originally by Nicki Minaj. Lyrics from the song are overlaid as text throughout the video, such as 'bitches couldn't get on my incline,' 'buns out, weiner,' 'but I gotta keep an eye out for Selener,' and 'beauty & the beast.'
audio_music: A fast-paced, high-energy pop/rap track ('Beauty and a Beat' by Justin Bieber) plays continuously throughout the video. The upbeat and youthful nature of the song creates a jarring and mocking contrast with the footage of the political figure.
editing_pacing: A very fast-paced montage with rapid cuts between dozens of short clips.
manipulation_or_satire: The video includes a clip of Donald Trump displaying an official NOAA weather map for Hurricane Dorian that has been visibly altered with a black marker to change the storm's projected path.
cultural_references: Beauty and a Beat (song by Justin Bieber ft. Nicki Minaj)
Ether (referencing the Nas diss track and slang for a verbal defeat)
central_claim: The video portrays Donald Trump as chaotic, absurd, and unfit for leadership through a rapid-fire montage of unflattering clips set to a jarringly upbeat pop song.
intended_effect: To ridicule Donald Trump and persuade the viewer to see him as an incompetent and unserious figure.
